notes.imports: go/parser.go records import paths on File.ImportPaths but never resolves or merges them; ParseFile only reads one file. Directory fixtures therefore cannot run here. Flipping this to true requires an import-resolving file API in the Go parser.
notes.comments: go/lexer.go discards '#' comments in skipWhitespaceAndComments, so no comment trivia reaches the AST and Emit cannot reproduce it.
